"AETHERIA – FANTASY MMORPG

Build a playable mobile-first fantasy MMORPG using detailed HD isometric pixel art, smooth animations and English UI. Build the actual game, not just a concept. Preserve working features.

WORLD: 8 regions with loading transitions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Add villages, quests, monsters, dungeons, bosses, hidden areas and respawns. Support walking, mounts and teleportation.

FACTIONS: Angels and Demons share the world but have unique appearances and wings. Choose faction at character creation. Wings unlock through quests or optional shop purchases, never drops or trading.

CLASSES: Warrior (Strength, sword, heavy armor), Mage (Intelligence, staff, robes), Archer (Dexterity, bow, light armor). Male/female characters, 3+ hairstyles and blue/green/brown eyes. Each class has normal attacks and ONE unique upgradeable main skill with 10 levels.

EQUIPMENT: Slots: weapon, helmet, chest, gloves, pants, boots, necklace, chain and earrings. Every class/faction has unique designs and restrictions. Everyone can farm, craft, buy and sell all equipment, but only the matching class/faction can equip it. Rarity visuals: Common/Grey same, Green improved, Blue/Epic similar, Legendary/Mythic/Divine increasingly spectacular. T3 normal, T2 small glow, T1 stronger glow. Effects must appear on characters.

DROPS AND FUSION: All equipment drops are T3. Drop chances: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%. Epic+ never drop directly. Fusion requires 4 identical items (class, faction, type, rarity, tier): T3→T2→T1→next rarity T3. No random destruction. Legendary is crafted using rare materials and boss drops; Mythic requires 4 matching Legendary; Divine requires 4 matching Mythic. Divine T3→T2→T1 is possible.

Fusion prices (T3→T2 / T2→T1 / T1→next T3):
Common 2k/3.5k/5k; Grey 7.5k/10k/15k; Green 20k/30k/45k; Blue 60k/85k/120k; Epic 175k/250k/350k; Legendary 750k/1.5m/3m; Mythic 5m/10m/20m; Divine 25m/50m/no next rarity. Legendary crafting 5m, Mythic fusion 30m, Divine fusion 120m. All prices configurable.

BOSSES AND BONUSES: Bosses drop tradeable bonus stones. Maximum 3 bonuses per item. Warrior: Strength/Life/Crit; Mage: Intelligence/Life/Crit; Archer: Dexterity/Life/Crit. Enchanter NPC applies or changes bonuses using boss items and Gold. Stronger bosses drop better stones. No random destruction. Maximum total Critical Chance 50%.

NPCS AND ECONOMY: Starting village: Blacksmith, Potion Merchant, Teleporter, Quest NPC, Storage, Enchanter. Potions sold in packages of 100: Health/Mana small/medium/large 5k/15k/40k; Attack Speed/Movement Speed 10k/25k/60k. Teleport costs: same region 500, nearby 2k, medium 5k, far 10k, endgame 20k, dungeon 25k–50k. Target endgame income 100k Gold/hour. Gold comes from monsters, quests and NPC sales; player trades only transfer existing Gold. No durability or repairs. Market stall 5k per 24h, player-set prices, no mandatory market tax. Track Gold entering/leaving the economy.

SHOP: Gems, costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, wings, premium and offers. Test purchases only; prepare future Google Play Billing.

BUILD: Mobile-friendly, modular, central configuration for prices and drops. Implement playable systems, inventory, progression and saving where supported. Test all features, fix bugs and report completed work and missing online-backend requirements. Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.

BUILD THE GAME NOW.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
